changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 6 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/3880-es-done-listo.md`

- names `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx` → `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `Hecho` moved to the 3:1 majority `Listo`, which is the value objectui#3546 slice seven had already chosen for `common.done`. `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx` pinned the old outlier as a recorded example of deliberate divergence; that pin now asserts the four as one value instead, and its note keeps the history plus the `Pending`/zh row, which remains a genuine deliberate split.

### `.changeset/6238-object-payload-enabled.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` — edited by this change

  > **No published type changed.** `ObjectMetadataPayload` is exported from its module but that module is not re-exported by `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, the package's only entry, so the removed `enabled?: boolean` was never on the published surface and no `**/src/index.ts` is touched. What consumers *can* observe is behaviour: `MetadataService` is reachable through the published `useMetadataService()` hook, both method signatures are unchanged (`PromiseANGLE-BRACKETS(void)`), and the HTTP request they issue changes from a `PUT` with a body to a `DELETE`.

### `.changeset/6515-record-form-current-user-normaliser.md`

- names `console/AppContent.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` — edited by this change

  > The normaliser moved from `console/AppContent.tsx` to `providers/expressionUser.ts`, beside the `ExpressionProvider` it feeds. That move is what made the fix available: `RecordFormPage` is `lazy()`-loaded BY `AppContent`, so importing the normaliser from its old home would have put a static edge from the split chunk back into the module it was split out of. Both `console/AppContent.js` and the package entry re-export the name, so `buildExpressionUser` is published exactly as before.

### `.changeset/6559-expression-user-input-contract.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` — edited by this change

  > WHAT BREAKS, AND FOR WHOM. This tightens a signature published from the package entry (`packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`), so an external caller that passes an unchecked or under-declared value stops compiling on upgrade. That is accepted (maintainer ruling 2026-08-27, option A): the only calls it refuses are calls that were never conformant with the contract the module already declared. It ships as `minor`, not `major` — objectui's major tracks `@objectstack`'s, so its own breaking changes ship as a minor with the break written down (`scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`). ⛔ Keeping `unknown` and ⛔ adding a second, wider entry point were both declined.

- names `console/AppContent.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` — edited by this change

  > NO RUNTIME BEHAVIOUR MOVES. All four in-repo production call sites pass `useAuth().user`, typed `AuthUser | null`, and type cleanly unchanged — two in `console/AppContent.tsx`, one in `views/RecordFormPage.tsx`, one in `apps/console`'s `InternalFormRoute.tsx`. The body is byte-equivalent: the same keys, the same `??` defaults, the same anonymous branch. ⛔ No consumer-side fallback was added; `id: u.id ?? null` remains the rejected shape (triage ruling 2026-08-26), because a lenient default in the consumer is what AGENTS.md #0.1 forbids and it silently equates "signed in, no id" with "signed out".

### `.changeset/7727-conditional-formatting-record-scope.md`

- names `providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `buildExpressionScope` (`providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx`) therefore no longer binds `app`, and `ROW_PREDICATE_ROOTS` no longer advertises it.

### `.changeset/record-alert-row-binding-4807.md`

- names `providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - **row-action shorthand** (`status == 'x'`) resolved nothing, so the evaluator threw. The legacy `${…}` path answers a throw with its own source text, a non-empty and therefore truthy string, so the verdict was **SHOWN on every row**. A banner the author had gated was permanently on screen. - **legacy `data.*`** (`data.status == 'x'`) did not throw at all. App-shell's ambient predicate scope (`providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx`) carries `data: {}`, so the predicate read that object instead of the row, compared `undefined`, and the verdict was a constant false — **never shown**.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Angle-bracketed names in the quoted prose above are rewritten as `ANGLE-BRACKETS(name)`: GitHub deletes tag-shaped fragments from a stored body, and a quote that silently loses the identifier it is about is worse than a visible repair.

Compared the checked-out tree with `f169a030a` (merge-base with origin/main): 36 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1466 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2049 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36131340869)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0bec5284e24f7cfc83641bdad24e675d07f6fd8a`

Rendered by an isolated review subagent spawned by the `domain:ui#4` seat; its served tier was checked against its transcript stamps (132 of 132 model stamps at the review tier). Adopted by this seat.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Identity.** `GET pulls/10617` resolves `head.sha` to `0bec5284e24f7cfc83641bdad24e675d07f6fd8a` on `claude/issue-5817-remove-app-sidebar`; `git merge-base` against `origin/main` is `50e41f7384bbd0e7405853ee1ca75e3dadb0af64`, as expected. Two commits, 42 files, 42 name-status rows confirmed by `git diff --name-status`.
- **Card and thread read.** Card body (five-box removal checklist: delete component and own tests plus the three shared halves, drop both barrel lines, fix the two named cross-references, re-run the census, one `minor` changeset in migration terms); hold `5386570531` (wait for the next major); ruling relay `5805876559` (maintainer: remove now, provided the objectstack console's function is unaffected; the `branding.logo` ledger gap predates this and is filed on objectstack by the seat); claim `5831076445` (objectui#7483 read as seat 2's, per the correction); the newest `os-dev-report` `5831889855`; the PR body; objectui#5720; and `.changeset/appsidebar-deprecated-5720.md` at the base. Every checklist box is satisfied at head.
- **(a) No live consumer: CONFIRMED.** Comment-masked scan of all 5494 tracked JS/TS files in a `git archive` export of head: `AppSidebar` appears in code only in the new pin's own string constants and test titles. No import, no lazy import, no route or registry key, and no string or path reference (`AppSidebar.js`, `layout/AppSidebar`) anywhere. Unmasked `git grep` at head: 33 non-CHANGELOG hits, every one prose (classified under (h)). objectstack `origin/main` at both `a08e059c61` (the dev's reading) and the current `f09d4122bc`: no `@object-ui/app-shell` import at all; the only mentions are CHANGELOGs, the dated audit `docs/audits/2026-06-appschema-property-liveness.md`, the ledger `packages/spec/liveness/app.json`, and two comments in `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`. Org-wide code search re-run read-only: `total_count` 52, 52 items, `incomplete_results` false; 47 objectui (indexed at a pre-merge main, so the deleted file is still listed and serves as the known-hit control), 4 objectstack, 1 `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` `src/sales/apps/crm.app.ts`, whose text match is a `//` comment saying `logo` renders via objectui's `AppSidebar.tsx`; it is not an import (a direct repository read of hotcrm is not enabled for this session, so that verdict rests on the search text match). Built entry: `package.json` `exports["."]` maps only to `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.d.ts`, which are built from `src/index.ts`; that entry and `layout/index.ts` no longer name `AppSidebar`, and no other subpath export exists, so the built `.d.ts` cannot re-export it. The dev's census is judged sound.
- **(b) The console is unaffected: CONFIRMED.** `ConsoleLayout.tsx` imports and mounts `UnifiedSidebar` (line 136) and `AppHeader` (line 142, which itself mounts `AppSwitcher` and the sign-out dropdown); `ConsoleShell.tsx`, `console/AppContent.tsx` and `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx` contain no sidebar mount in code. Comment-masked, blank-line-insensitive diff of every non-test source file in the surface: `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `nav-menu-renderer.tsx`, `ActionResultDialog.tsx`, `ConsoleShell.tsx`, `console/AppContent.tsx`, `StarredApps.tsx`, `FavoritesProvider.tsx`, `ExpressionProvider.tsx`, `auth/AuthProvider.tsx`, `auth/UserMenu.tsx`, `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`, `AppManagementPage.tsx` all report no code difference; the only code deltas are the single `AppSidebar,` line in `src/index.ts` and the single `export { AppSidebar }` line in `layout/index.ts`. Side effects: the deleted `AppSidebar.tsx` has, at top level, only imports, `function useNavOrder`, the alias `const getIcon = resolveIcon;` and `export function AppSidebar`; no registration, no module-level call, nothing the barrel evaluated for effect. `sideEffects` in `package.json` names `dist/index.js` and specific renderer files, none of them the deleted module.
- **(c) The shared tests: CONFIRMED, no weakening.** Masked diff of `systemNavDatasourcesHop`, `systemNavObjectsHop` and `systemNavSettingsTarget`: the only code removed is the `import { AppSidebar }` line and the one `AppSidebar` `it(...)` block per file. Every `UnifiedSidebar` case sits outside every hunk, so it is byte-identical to the base; the CONTROL cases are code-identical, with one comment phrase changed in each of the two hop files. `DATASOURCES_TARGET`, `OBJECTS_TARGET` and `SYSTEM_HUB` are still consumed by the `UnifiedSidebar` expectation table (lines 215-223), so nothing dangles. `UnifiedSidebar.derivedAreaVisibility` and `navItemVisibleEvaluated`: no code difference at all, comment-only.
- **(d) The two out-of-claim code edits: forced and non-weakening.** `homeAffordancesFollowDeclaration-7256.test.ts` reads each `AFFORDANCES.file` with `readFileSync`, so the `AppSidebar.tsx` row would throw ENOENT; only that row is removed, the `AppHeader` and `UnifiedSidebar` rows and their expressions are untouched, and a note beside the table records the departure. `residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx` reads `APP_SIDEBAR` through `sourceOf` in three places (single-site table, `MULTI` table, the binding-style loop); `layout.systemNav.datasources` is now pinned at `UNIFIED_SIDEBAR` in the single-site table and `MULTI` keeps `[UNIFIED_SIDEBAR]`, so the surviving site is held to the same string as before; the "Nine files" comment became "Eight". No assertion on any surviving component was dropped or loosened.
- **(e) The export-absence pin is real.** `appSidebarRemoved-5817.test.ts` reads both barrels from disk, masks comments with `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` (`maskComments` is exported at line 501), asserts `existsSync` false on the component, `not.toMatch(/\bAppSidebar\b/)` per barrel, and a CONTROL that the same reader finds `UnifiedSidebar` in both barrels and the surviving file on disk. It mirrors `rootLandingHasOneResolver-10042.test.ts` (same helper import, same `@ts-expect-error` annotation). Probe in the scratch export with plain node and the repo's own mask helper: head barrels are clean and match the control; with the base barrels substituted, the two barrel cases fail and the file-absence and CONTROL cases pass, reproducing the reverse proof's "2 failed, 2 passed".
- **(f) Changeset truth: CONFIRMED.** `.changeset/5817-remove-app-sidebar.md` declares `'@object-ui/app-shell': minor` only; opens "**Breaking:**"; says the bump is `minor` only because the fixed group never declares `major`; gives the migration (`UnifiedSidebar`, same `activeAppName` prop, which both components take) and names three differences, each true at head: `UnifiedSidebar` imports no `AppSwitcher` or `UserMenu` and draws no bottom strip while the deleted file drew a header switcher, a footer user menu with `user.logout`, and a fixed bottom mobile nav; it reads `useNavigationContext()` and picks `homeNavigation` for `context === 'home'` (lines 163, 385); its whole Administration cluster is inside `if (isWorkspaceAdmin)` (line 328) where the deleted fallback gated only `sys-marketplace` (base lines 363-364). No line-address citations.
